# Lab 1.5: Use the bq Command-Line Tool

## What We Are Going to Do
Use the main `bq` commands from Cloud Shell to list, create, inspect, copy and delete BigQuery resources.

## Steps

1. **[CLI] Make standard SQL the default.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">cat &gt; ~/.bigqueryrc &lt;&lt;'EOF'
[query]
--use_legacy_sql=false
[mk]
--use_legacy_sql=false
EOF
bq help | head -40</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **[CLI] Create and inspect.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">bq --location=US mk --dataset --description "bq CLI practice" $PROJECT_ID:lab01_cli
bq ls
bq show --format=prettyjson lab01_cli</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


3. **[CLI] Query into a table, then copy it.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">bq query --destination_table=lab01_cli.names_wa \
  'SELECT name, SUM(number) AS total FROM `bigquery-public-data.usa_names.usa_1910_current`
   WHERE state = "WA" GROUP BY name'
bq head -n 5 lab01_cli.names_wa
bq cp lab01_cli.names_wa lab01_cli.names_wa_copy
bq ls lab01_cli</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


4. **[CLI] Check cost before running.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">bq query --dry_run 'SELECT * FROM `bigquery-public-data.usa_names.usa_1910_current`'</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


5. **[Console] Confirm in the UI.** Refresh the Explorer and open `lab01_cli`. Both tables are there. Open **Personal history** at the bottom of Studio to see the CLI jobs.

6. **[CLI] Clean up.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">bq rm -r -f -d lab01_cli</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| `.bigqueryrc` | Standard SQL by default |
| Copy job | `names_wa_copy` created |
| CLI jobs | Visible in console history |
| Clean-up | `lab01_cli` removed with `bq rm -r` |
